title: The Sixteenth Yearbook
author: S. M. Okafor
blurb: Xanthe Crane, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
